_comment: Per-string context pushed to Crowdin by `npm run i18n:context`. One line per key saying where the string appears and what constrains it — the facts a translator cannot get from the English alone. Written when the string is, by whoever ran /wording. Keys mirror en.json.
game_header.game_actions.chaosbag: Tooltip on an icon button in the game header. No visible label, so this is the only text naming the action.
game_header.game_actions.mute: Tooltip on an icon button in the game header.
game_header.game_actions.fullscreen: Tooltip on an icon button in the game header.
game_header.game_actions.menu: Tooltip on an icon button in the game header.
game_header.current_game_phase.round: Label beside the round number in the game header. Very tight — one short word. Several editions keep the English loanword.
game_header.current_game_phase.mythos: Current phase, shown in the game header. Fantasy Flight rules term.
game_header.current_game_phase.investiga: Current phase, shown in the game header. Fantasy Flight rules term.
game_header.current_game_phase.enemy: Current phase, shown in the game header. Fantasy Flight rules term.
game_header.current_game_phase.upkeep: Current phase, shown in the game header. Fantasy Flight rules term.
global_game_info.act: Caption above the current act card. One word. Fantasy Flight rules term — use the printed word.
global_game_info.agenda: Caption above the current agenda card. One word. Fantasy Flight rules term — use the printed word.
game_view.current_investigator_panel.act: Tooltip on an action pip granted by another card. {{originator}} is that card's name.
Tooltip on an ordinary, unspent action pip.
Button below the action pips. Two words at most.
Button in the actions area. `#n#` renders as the Arkham symbol glyph and must survive verbatim.
Button in the actions area. `#n#` renders as the Arkham symbol glyph and must survive verbatim.
Button in the actions area. `#f#` renders as the Arkham symbol glyph and must survive verbatim.
Tooltip on a spent action pip, naming what it was spent on. {{target}} is a location.
Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is a location.
Tooltip on a spent action pip. No target.
Tooltip on a spent action pip. No target.
Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is a card name.
Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is a card name.
Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is an enemy.
Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is an enemy.
Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is an enemy. Evade is a Fantasy Flight action name.
Restriction shown on the actions area. `@Evade@` renders bold italic and must survive verbatim.
main_menu.login_to_continue: Main menu button, shown in place of Continue when signed out. Three words at most — the button does not grow.
main_menu.continue: Main menu button, resumes the most recent game. Three words at most.
main_menu.continue_tooltip: Tooltip on the Continue button. Two lines: the `\n` is deliberate. {{lastPlayed}} is a formatted date.
main_menu.new_game: Main menu button. Three words at most.
main_menu.new_game_error.title: Title of the dialog shown when creating a game fails. Atmospheric — the world speaks, not the software. One line, does not wrap.
main_menu.new_game_error.message: Body of that dialog. Plain and factual, saying what happened and what to do. One or two sentences.
main_menu.load_game: Main menu button, opens the Case files screen. Should match case_files.title.
main_menu.decks: Main menu button. In-world word for decks; see the glossary.
main_menu.settings: Main menu button. Also the title of the settings dialog it opens.
case_files.title: Screen title. One line. Should match main_menu.load_game.
case_files.opened: Metadata line on a case file card. {{date}} is already formatted for the locale.
case_files.last_played: Metadata line on a case file card. {{date}} is already formatted for the locale.
case_files.empty.message: Shown when the reader has no games yet. Two lines: the `\n` is deliberate. Atmospheric but must still say plainly that the list is empty.
case_files.empty.action: Button under the empty state, starts a new game.
case_files.error.title: Heading when the list fails to load. Atmospheric — dread in the heading. One line.
case_files.error.message: Body under that heading. Plain: what happened, in the reader's terms.
case_files.error.retry: Button beside that message. Two words at most.
case_files.back: Button returning to the main menu. One word if your language allows.
auth.sign_in.title: Dialog title for the sign-in choice. Atmospheric. One line, does not wrap.
auth.sign_in.message: Lead paragraph under that title, explaining the choice below. Two sentences.
auth.sign_in.anonymous.title: Heading of the left-hand panel: the anonymous account option. Short.
auth.sign_in.anonymous.lead: One-sentence summary under that heading, saying who the option suits.
auth.sign_in.anonymous.credentials: Bullet in the anonymous panel. Terse, parallel with the other three bullets and with the opposite panel.
auth.sign_in.anonymous.device: Bullet in the anonymous panel. Terse and parallel.
auth.sign_in.anonymous.name: Bullet in the anonymous panel. Terse and parallel.
auth.sign_in.anonymous.duration: Bullet in the anonymous panel. Terse and parallel.
auth.sign_in.credentials.title: Heading of the right-hand panel: the registered account option. Short.
auth.sign_in.credentials.credentials: Bullet in the registered panel. Reads against its opposite number in the anonymous panel.
auth.sign_in.credentials.device: Bullet in the registered panel. Reads against its opposite number.
auth.sign_in.credentials.name: Bullet in the registered panel. Reads against its opposite number.
auth.sign_in.credentials.duration: Bullet in the registered panel. Reads against its opposite number.
auth.credentials_form.title: Dialog title once the reader chooses to give credentials. Atmospheric, one line.
auth.credentials_form.legend: Fieldset legend above the three inputs.
auth.credentials_form.email: Label for the email input. One word.
auth.credentials_form.username: Label for the name input. One word.
auth.credentials_form.password: Label for the password input. One word.
auth.credentials_form.submit: Primary button of the credentials form.
auth.credentials_form.back: Button returning to the previous choice.
auth.credentials_form.cancel: Button dismissing the form without signing in. Softer than a bare Cancel.
auth.credentials_form.errors.wrong_passw: Inline error under the form when the credentials are rejected. The desk refuses without explaining — do not add a reason.
auth.credentials_form.errors.generic: Inline error under the form when the request itself failed. Says the fault is the archive's, not the reader's.
settings.language: Label of the language row in the settings dialog. The value beside it is the language's own name and is not translated.
settings.cancel: Settings dialog button, discards changes. One word.
settings.account.row: Label of the account row in the settings dialog, which opens the account view.
settings.account.title: Title of the account view. Replaces the dialog's own title, so it must read as a heading on its own.
settings.account.back: Button returning from the account view to settings.
settings.account.anonymous.name_label: Label beside the generated name of an anonymous account.
settings.account.anonymous.state: One-line statement of what kind of admission the reader holds. Sits above the detail line.
settings.account.anonymous.detail: Explains the consequence of the state above: this account lives on one device only. Two sentences at most.
settings.account.anonymous.upgrade: Button turning an anonymous account into a permanent one. In-world word for registering.
settings.account.anonymous.sign_out: Button. Destructive for an anonymous account — it opens the warning dialog below.
settings.account.permanent.name_label: Label beside the reader's chosen name.
settings.account.permanent.state: One-line statement of what kind of admission the reader holds.
settings.account.permanent.detail: Explains the consequence: files follow them to any device.
settings.account.permanent.sign_out: Button. Not destructive here — the account survives.
settings.account.signed_out.state: One-line statement shown when nobody is signed in.
settings.account.signed_out.detail: Explains what signing in would get them.
settings.account.sign_out_warning.title: Title of the confirm dialog before an anonymous sign-out. States the stake plainly; this is the one irreversible action in the app.
settings.account.sign_out_warning.messag: Body of that dialog. Must make the loss unmistakable without scolding.
settings.account.sign_out_warning.confir: Confirm button naming both halves of what happens. Deliberately longer than the usual button budget — do not shorten it into a lie.
settings.account.sign_out_warning.cancel: Cancel button, in-world: it names the thing being kept rather than saying Cancel. Must still be unmistakable as the safe choice.
confirm_dialog.confirm: Default confirm button for the generic confirm dialog. One word — it has no context of its own.
confirm_dialog.cancel: Default cancel button for the generic confirm dialog. One word.
alert_dialog.ok: Sole button dismissing a generic alert. One word.
game_view.current_investigator_panel.thr: One entry in a randomised pool shown when no enemies are engaged. Appears alone, so it must stand by itself and match the length and rhythm of the rest of the pool.
